title: Topic 3: Family & Relationships - Vocabulary
description: Core words for family & relationships: mother, father, brother, sister, family, friend. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
introductionText:
mother = your mom
father = your dad
brother = a boy/man with the same parents
sister = a girl/woman with the same parents
family = mother + father + brothers + sisters...
friend = a person you like, not family
+ phrase bank: This is my... | I have a... | His name is... |
Her name is...

grammarBlocks.title: possessive 'S (Ana's brother) + possessive adjectives HIS /
grammarBlocks.explanation: possessive 'S (Ana's brother) + possessive adjectives HIS / HER / OUR (extends T2's my/your)
patterns: She is... / He is... (3rd person to be, natural
extension of T1-2 to be work)

questions.question: Your mother and your father are your ___.
A girl with the same mother and father as you is your ___.
Tap the missing word: This is Paulo. He is not my family. He is my ___.
Tap the missing word: I have one brother and one ___. Her name is Lia.
Which one is NOT a family word?
Grammar: Ana has a brother. He is ___ brother.
Grammar: This is my father. ___ name is Carlos.

explanations.A1-T03-VOC-Q3: A friend is a person you like who is not family.
explanations.A1-T03-VOC-Q5: City is from Topic 2 - it is a place, not family.
explanations.A1-T03-VOC-Q6: Who is this? -> answer with This is my...
explanations.A1-T03-VOC-Q7: Ana's brother = the brother of Ana. Use apostrophe + s.
explanations.A1-T03-VOC-Q8: Father = man -> HIS. Mother = woman -> HER.
